claims: PlayStation Network (PSN) experienced an outage on March 21, 2026.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected PS4/PS5 gaming.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected social features.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected store access.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected launching games.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected app usage.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected tournaments.
The March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage affected trophies.
Reports of the March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage initially peaked over 14,000.
Reports of the March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network outage are decreasing.
The official PlayStation Network status shows improvement.
No official reason has been disclosed for the March 21, 2026 PlayStation Network service disruption.
